no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Cardio Diagnostics is a diagnostics-only medical-technology company. Its commercial products (Epi+Gen CHD, PrecisionCHD, HeartRisk, CardioInnovate360) are AI-driven epigenetics/genetics blood tests categorized as laboratory-developed tests (LDTs) for coronary heart disease risk assessment and detection. The company does not develop or sponsor therapeutic drug candidates; consequently it has no Phase 1/2/3 drug trials on ClinicalTrials.gov as a sponsor.
